# Script introduction

`s38` showed that, with temperature-independent measures, dryness varies almost as much within 1 °C temperature bins as overall in every contrast, so a drought effect can in principle be told apart from a warmth effect. This notebook makes the comparison the sixth external review asked for (`writing/research_roadmap.md`, rank 5): **among the places where mutualists and their facultative relatives both occur at comparable temperatures, are the mutualists' places drier?** It compares the species' occurrences directly (a case–case comparison), so it needs no background; it assumes that mutualists and facultative relatives were recorded in comparable ways, which presence data cannot guarantee.

This analysis was designed after the results of `s36`–`s38` were known; it is sequential, and its design is fixed here before it is run.

**Hypotheses and variables** (fixed in the roadmap):

- **H1 warmth:** annual mean temperature, compared within bins of dry-season length (1 month);
- **H2 dry-season duration:** the longest run of months below 50 mm, compared within 1 °C temperature bins;
- **H3 water stress:** the annual climatic water deficit, compared within 1 °C temperature bins.

**Estimand.** For each species, its mean residual of the variable within its contrast: each occupied pixel's value minus the mean of the pixels of the same bin (bins held by both strategies only; every species weighted equally in the bin mean), averaged over the species' pixels, in SD units of the variable over the land of the eight regions. A positive mutualist-minus-facultative difference means mutualists occupy drier (or, for H1, warmer) places than their relatives at the same temperature (or dry-season length).

**Replication.** Species are the units within a contrast; the standard error of a species' score comes from 2° blocks of its pixels. Per contrast, the inverse-variance difference between strategies, with the between-species variance of a hierarchical meta-analysis; contrasts of one origin combined; a random-effects meta-analysis over origins, the number of origins in each direction, and leave-one-origin-out. Holm adjustment over the three hypotheses.

**Primary analysis:** the origin contrasts of `s37` with cleaned records, 1 °C bins. **Sensitivity (fixed now):** without the multi-genus Aphnaeinae origin (34 mutualists against 2 facultative species); only origins with at least two species of each strategy; the within-genus contrasts of version 1; supplemented records without the pixels where the parent cleaning removed records (`s39`); matching on temperature bin and biome together; 2 °C bins; and an unmatched comparison (no bins), to show what matching does.

**Outcome rules (fixed now), per hypothesis:** *consistent support* if the pooled 95% interval excludes zero, at least two thirds of origins share its sign, and every leave-one-origin-out estimate shares it; *inconsistent* if the pooled interval excludes zero but these conditions fail; *not detected* otherwise.

A full run takes about 5 min.

```{r define_helpers}
# Species scores within contrasts: residual of x relative to the species-weighted mean of its matching bin
species_scores <- function(cp, x, match_var, width, sds, by_biome = FALSE) {
  d <- copy(cp)
  d[, xs := get(x) / sds[[x]]]
  d[, bin := if (is.na(match_var)) "all" else as.character(floor(get(match_var) / width))]
  if (by_biome) d[, bin := paste(bin, biome)]
  shared <- d[, .(both = uniqueN(strategy) == 2), by = .(contrast, bin)][both == TRUE]
  d <- merge(d, shared[, .(contrast, bin)], by = c("contrast", "bin"))
  ref <- d[, .(sp_mean = mean(xs)), by = .(contrast, bin, pool_key)][, .(bin_mean = mean(sp_mean)), by = .(contrast, bin)]
  d <- merge(d, ref, by = c("contrast", "bin"))
  d[, r := xs - bin_mean]
  d[, block := paste(floor(lon / block_deg), floor(lat / block_deg))]
  d[, {
    bm <- .SD[, .(r = mean(r)), by = block]$r
    se <- if (length(bm) >= 3) sd(bm) / sqrt(length(bm)) else sd(r) / sqrt(.N)
    .(score = mean(r), se = max(se, 0.01), pixels = .N, blocks = length(bm))
  }, by = .(origin, contrast, pool_key, species, strategy)]
}
# Two-stage comparison over origins, with leave-one-origin-out
compare <- function(s) {
  s <- s[is.finite(score) & is.finite(se)]
  s <- s[contrast %in% s[, .(both = uniqueN(strategy) == 2), by = contrast][both == TRUE]$contrast]
  if (uniqueN(s$origin) < 2) return(NULL)
  s[, m := as.integer(strategy == "m")]
  h <- tryCatch(rma.mv(score, se^2, mods = ~ m, random = list(~ 1 | contrast, ~ 1 | species), data = s,
                       method = "REML"), error = function(e) NULL)
  tau2 <- if (is.null(h)) 0 else h$sigma2[2]
  per_origin <- function(ss) {
    u <- ss[, { w <- 1 / (se^2 + tau2)
      .(difference = sum((w * score)[m == 1]) / sum(w[m == 1]) - sum((w * score)[m == 0]) / sum(w[m == 0]),
        se = sqrt(1 / sum(w[m == 1]) + 1 / sum(w[m == 0])), mutualists = sum(m), facultative = sum(1 - m)) },
      by = .(origin, contrast)]
    u[, .(difference = sum(difference / se^2) / sum(1 / se^2), se = sqrt(1 / sum(1 / se^2)),
          mutualists = sum(mutualists), facultative = sum(facultative)), by = origin]
  }
  o <- per_origin(s)
  p <- rma(o$difference, sei = o$se, method = "REML")
  loo <- vapply(o$origin, function(x) { oo <- o[origin != x]
    if (nrow(oo) < 2) NA_real_ else rma(oo$difference, sei = oo$se, method = "REML")$b[1] }, numeric(1))
  list(origins = o, summary = data.table(origins = nrow(o), positive = sum(o$difference > 0),
                                         pooled = p$b[1], pooled_se = p$se, pooled_low = p$ci.lb, pooled_high = p$ci.ub,
                                         pooled_p = p$pval, tau2_origins = p$tau2, loo_min = min(loo, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         loo_max = max(loo, na.rm = TRUE), species = nrow(s)))
}
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
}
theme_figure <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
          plot.title.position = "plot", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}
```

# Occupied pixels of every setting

The occupied pixels of each contrast with their climate (`s38`) and biome (RESOLVE, `s01`): cleaned records (origin and within-genus contrasts), and supplemented records without the pixels where the parent cleaning had removed records (`s39`).

*Inputs:* s38/ contrast_pixels.rds, mechanism_pixels.rds; s37/ contrasts.csv, presences.csv; s39/supplement_pixels.csv; s01/ realm_biome_10m.tif
*Outputs:* case_pixels.rds

```{r pixels}
pix <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s38, "mechanism_pixels.rds"))
rb <- rast(file.path(dir_s01, "realm_biome_10m.tif"))
pix[, biome := rb[["biome"]][cell][, 1]]
cp <- readRDS(file.path(dir_s38, "contrast_pixels.rds"))
cp <- merge(cp, pix[, .(cell, lon, lat, biome)], by = "cell")
cp[, records := "cleaned"]
ct <- fread(file.path(dir_s37, "contrasts.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[
  occurrences == "supplemented" & scheme == "origins"]
pres <- fread(file.path(dir_s37, "presences.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))
bad <- fread(file.path(dir_s39, "supplement_pixels.csv"), colClasses = c(pool_key = "character"))[
  reason != "No record in the parent download", .(pool_key, cell)]
pres <- pres[!paste(pool_key, cell) %in% paste(bad$pool_key, bad$cell)]
sup <- merge(ct[, .(pool_key, strategy, area, origin, contrast, scheme, species, genus)], pres[, .(pool_key, area, cell)],
             by = c("pool_key", "area"))
sup <- merge(sup, pix[, .(cell, bio01, dry_run50, cwd, lon, lat, biome)], by = "cell")
sup[, records := "supplemented, filtered"]
case_pix <- rbind(cp, sup, use.names = TRUE)
saveRDS(case_pix, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_pixels.rds"))
sds <- pix[, lapply(.SD, sd), .SDcols = c("bio01", "dry_run50", "cwd")]
saveRDS(sds, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "variable_sds.rds"))
print(case_pix[, .(pixels = .N, species = uniqueN(pool_key), contrasts = uniqueN(contrast)), by = .(records, scheme)])
```

```{r clear_pixels, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

# Species scores and comparisons

*Inputs:* s41/ case_pixels.rds, variable_sds.rds
*Outputs:* species_scores.csv, case_summary.csv, case_origins.csv

```{r compare}
cp <- readRDS(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_pixels.rds"))
sds <- readRDS(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "variable_sds.rds"))
base <- cp[records == "cleaned" & scheme == "origins"]
settings <- list(
  list(setting = "Primary: origin contrasts, cleaned records, 1-unit bins", d = base, width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Without the multi-genus Aphnaeinae origin", d = base[origin != aphnaeinae_origin], width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Origins with at least two species of each strategy", d = base, width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE, balanced = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Within-genus contrasts (version 1)", d = cp[records == "cleaned" & scheme == "within"], width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Supplemented records, cleaning-removed pixels excluded", d = cp[records == "supplemented, filtered"], width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Matched on bin and biome", d = base, width = 1, biome = TRUE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Bins twice as wide", d = base, width = 2, biome = FALSE, match = TRUE),
  list(setting = "Unmatched (no bins)", d = base, width = 1, biome = FALSE, match = FALSE))
res <- list(); orig <- list(); scores <- list()
for (st in settings) for (i in seq_len(nrow(hypotheses))) {
  hy <- hypotheses[i]
  sc <- species_scores(st$d, hy$variable, if (st$match) hy$matching else NA, st$width * hy$width, sds, st$biome)
  if (isTRUE(st$balanced)) {
    keep <- sc[, .(m = uniqueN(pool_key[strategy == "m"]), f = uniqueN(pool_key[strategy == "f"])), by = origin][m >= 2 & f >= 2]$origin
    sc <- sc[origin %in% keep]
  }
  retained <- sc[, sum(pixels)] / st$d[, .N]
  out <- compare(sc)
  if (is.null(out)) next
  tag <- data.table(setting = st$setting, hypothesis = hy$h, label = hy$label)
  res[[length(res) + 1]] <- cbind(tag, out$summary, pixels_retained = retained)
  orig[[length(orig) + 1]] <- cbind(tag, out$origins)
  if (st$setting == settings[[1]]$setting) scores[[length(scores) + 1]] <- cbind(tag, sc)
}
res <- rbindlist(res)
res[, p_holm := p.adjust(pooled_p, "holm"), by = setting]
res[, outcome := fifelse(pooled_low > 0 | pooled_high < 0,
                         fifelse(positive >= 2 / 3 * origins & sign(loo_min) == sign(pooled) & sign(loo_max) == sign(pooled),
                                 "Consistent support", "Inconsistent"), "Not detected")]
write_table(res, file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_summary.csv"))
write_table(rbindlist(orig), file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_origins.csv"))
write_table(rbindlist(scores), file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "species_scores.csv"))
print(res[, .(setting = substr(setting, 1, 40), hypothesis, origins, positive, pooled = round(pooled, 2),
              low = round(pooled_low, 2), high = round(pooled_high, 2), p = round(pooled_p, 3), p_holm = round(p_holm, 3),
              retained = round(pixels_retained, 2), outcome)])
```

```{r clear_compare, include=FALSE}
invisible(gc())
```

# Figures

## Per origin

For each hypothesis (primary analysis): every origin's difference between mutualists and facultative relatives at matched temperature (or dry-season length), with 95% intervals, and the random-effects estimate.

*Inputs:* s41/ case_origins.csv, case_summary.csv
*Outputs:* plot_case_origins.png

```{r plot_case_origins}
o <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_origins.csv"))[grepl("^Primary", setting)]
s <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_summary.csv"))[grepl("^Primary", setting)]
short <- function(x) vapply(strsplit(x, " + ", fixed = TRUE), function(g)
  if (length(g) > 2) paste0(g[1], " + ", length(g) - 1, " genera") else paste(g, collapse = " + "), character(1))
o[, row := sprintf("%s (%d/%d)", short(origin), mutualists, facultative)]
lev <- o[hypothesis == "H2"][order(difference)]$row
d <- rbind(o[, .(hypothesis, label, row, difference, low = difference - 1.96 * se, high = difference + 1.96 * se, pooled = FALSE)],
           s[, .(hypothesis, label, row = "All origins", difference = pooled, low = pooled_low, high = pooled_high, pooled = TRUE)])
d[, row := factor(row, c("All origins", lev))]
d[, label := factor(label, unique(s$label))]
fig <- ggplot(d, aes(difference, row)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = low, xmax = high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y", colour = "#3B3B3B") +
  geom_point(aes(shape = pooled), size = 2.2, colour = "#D55E00") +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 3, labeller = label_wrap_gen(40)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 18), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Mutualists minus facultative relatives at matched conditions (SD units)", y = NULL,
       title = "Matched case-case comparison: one estimate per origin",
       subtitle = "In brackets: mutualist/facultative species; positive: mutualists in warmer (H1) or drier (H2, H3) places") +
  theme_figure() + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))
save_figure(fig, "plot_case_origins", 10, 4.5)
fig
```

```{r clear_plot_case_origins, include=FALSE}
rm(list = setdiff(ls(), setup_objects))
invisible(gc())
```

## Sensitivity

The pooled estimate of every setting, for each hypothesis.

*Inputs:* s41/case_summary.csv
*Outputs:* plot_case_sensitivity.png

```{r plot_case_sensitivity}
s <- fread(file.path(dir_data_intermediate, "case_summary.csv"))
s[, setting := factor(setting, rev(unique(setting)))]
s[, label := factor(label, unique(label))]
fig <- ggplot(s, aes(pooled, setting)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = pooled_low, xmax = pooled_high), width = 0, linewidth = 0.5, orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "#D55E00") +
  geom_text(aes(x = Inf, label = paste0(positive, "/", origins)), hjust = 1.1, size = 2.3, colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 3, labeller = label_wrap_gen(40)) +
  labs(x = "Pooled difference, mutualists minus facultative relatives (SD units; 95% interval)", y = NULL,
       title = "Matched case-case comparison: sensitivity", subtitle = "Labels: origins with a positive difference") +
  theme_figure()
save_figure(fig, "plot_case_sensitivity", 11, 4.5)
fig
```

